question:
Read the below statements regarding Aman Sehrawat's performance at the Paris 2024 Olympics:**
Statement I: Aman Sehrawat won the bronze medal in the Men's 57kg freestyle wrestling event by defeating Darian Cruz of Puerto Rico.

Statement II: With this win, at the age of 21 years and 24 days, he surpassed PV Sindhu to become India's youngest-ever individual Olympic medalist.

Which of the following is correct**?

options.text: Neither statement I nor II is correct
Both statements I and II are correct

solution:
The correct answer is __**4) Both statements I and II are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement I:** Aman Sehrawat won the **bronze medal** in the **Men's 57kg freestyle wrestling** event by defeating **Darian Cruz of Puerto Rico**.

 
 
• This statement is **correct**, as Aman Sehrawat's victory in wrestling at the **Paris 2024 Olympics** brought glory to India. He showcased exceptional skills and determination in the competition.
 
• The match against Darian Cruz was decisive, and Sehrawat secured the **third position** on the podium.
 
 
 
• **Statement II:** With this win, at the age of **21 years and 24 days**, Aman Sehrawat surpassed **PV Sindhu** to become **India's youngest-ever individual Olympic medalist**.
 
 
• This statement is also **correct**. Previously, PV Sindhu held the record as the youngest Indian to win an individual Olympic medal at the age of **21 years and 106 days** during the **Rio 2016 Olympics**.
 
• Sehrawat's remarkable achievement at such a young age set a new benchmark in Indian sports history.
 
 
 
• Both statements are factually accurate and demonstrate the significance of Aman Sehrawat's achievement at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**.
 
• His accomplishment not only highlights his personal talent but also emphasizes India's growing prowess in **freestyle wrestling** on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aman Sehrawat:**

 
 
• Aman Sehrawat is a rising star in Indian wrestling, known for his agility, technique, and determination.
 
• He has been mentored and trained under some of India's best coaches, contributing to his success on the international stage.
 
 
 
• **India's Olympic Record:**
 
 
• India has a history of producing outstanding wrestlers like **Sushil Kumar**, **Bajrang Punia**, and **Sakshi Malik**, who have brought home Olympic medals.
 
• Aman Sehrawat's win adds to India's growing legacy in wrestling at the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Youngest Indian Olympic Medalists:**
 
 
• Before Aman Sehrawat, **PV Sindhu** held the record for being the youngest individual Olympic medalist from India.
 
• Other young achievers include **Neeraj Chopra** (javelin throw) and **Sakshi Malik** (wrestling).
 
 
 
• **Paris 2024 Olympics:**
 
 
• The **Paris 2024 Olympics** is a significant event, showcasing athletes from around the globe in various sports disciplines.
 
• India has been focusing on improving its performance in wrestling, athletics, and other sports through initiatives like **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS):**

 
 
• This initiative by the Indian government aims to provide financial and infrastructural support to athletes for Olympic preparation.
 
• Aman Sehrawat is among the athletes who have benefited from this scheme, which has significantly contributed to India's improved Olympic performance.
 
 
 
• **Freestyle Wrestling:**
 
 
• Freestyle wrestling is one of the two wrestling disciplines featured in the Olympics, the other being Greco-Roman.
 
• India has traditionally excelled in freestyle wrestling, with numerous medalists in this category.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The first Indian to win an Olympic medal in wrestling was **K.D. Jadhav**, who secured bronze in the **1952 Helsinki Olympics**.
 
• Since then, wrestling has been a prominent sport for India in international competitions.
